text: しりたいことが　かいてない！

structure.en: the thing I want to know

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with ある says something has been done and is left that way; ない is the 'not' form of ある. かいてない = 'isn't written here'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on the end of a verb says the speaker wants to do it. しりたい = 'want to know'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase put straight in front of a thing describes that thing. しりたいこと = 'the thing I want to know'.
